summary: Southern Leyte 1st District representative with 52 principal-authored bills. Authored people's participation in national budgeting, an anti-dynasty ban, a National Filipino Family Commission and civil registration. Co-authored universal health care amendments, a national shelter program, Malasakit Centers in private hospitals, stronger NFA rice powers, a CDC and the national minimum wage.
caveat: Economic evidence is all co-authored. Family Commission bill is a single social issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored universal health care amendments and Malasakit Centers in private hospitals (-3), a national shelter program (-2), stronger NFA rice powers (-2) and the national minimum wage (-2). All co-authored.
